test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Five girls, M, N, O, P, and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. P is an immediate neighbour of M and N. Q is second to the left of P. N and Q are the immediate neighbours of O. Who is sitting third to the right of Q?
solution:
Given: Five girls, M, N, O, P, and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Q is second to the left of P.

2) P is an immediate neighbour of M and N.

3) N and Q are the immediate neighbours of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/856d05135461a24ecff0c280c048de89b0fd1b557e214d7f87f7fd3cf745a2fd.png] 

So, 'N' is sitting third to the right of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
